title: Light Hammer
summary: Simple thrown hammer dealing 1d4 Bludgeoning with the BG3 Concussive Smash action.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength. Simple one-handed melee weapon, 5 ft reach. Light, Thrown and Dippable.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, melee weapon damage. Constitution save or Dazed for 2 turns. The action uses the higher of weapon-action DC +2 and spell save DC. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
